english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an adaptable person, approach, or way of thinking.
Use this when dynamic means able to adjust easily to new conditions or approaches.

examples.english: This person is adaptable and knows how to adjust when situations change.
examples.traditional: 呢個人好靈活，遇到新情況都識變通。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 ling4 wut6 jyu6 dou3 san1 cing4 fong3 dou1 sik1 bin3 tung1

examples.english: When clients change their requests at the last minute, we need to be dynamic in handling them.
examples.traditional: 面對客人臨時改要求，我哋要靈活處理。
examples.jyutping: min6 deoi3 haak3 jan4 lam4 si4 goi2 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ling4 wut6 cyu2 lei5
